explanation: Batch 3 (waves 51-55) against batch 2's close: 40 households +5.7% (band 3) from one seed, 47 (+23.8%: web +2.1 s, homesteads +1.0 s), and seed 25's web refused. Bisected per commit at 40 households (m:batch3-pair-and-controls): seed 47 holds at 13.8-13.9 s through wave 51 and the belt-crossing change, rises to 14.7 s at wave 52's heap-along-the-bearing commit and 15.7 s at the barn seat's withdrawal (19f69655c), and stays there through waves 53-55. Both are re-seatings of the privy and its heap (0042, 0047): the farms' footprints change, the seating packs the 40 farms differently, and the web's settle does more knot and straighten work on the new layout (profiled: settle_knots and resettle_straightened). Controls at HEAD: the grove top-up off moves seed 47 by -0.2 s, KNOTTED_TRIES 1 by +0.3 s in the web (noise), wave 52's fixture_seats.py with the barn seat restored by -1.0 s (and seed 4 +0.8 s: a layout effect, not a steady cost). Seed 4's hinterland growth (+1.7 s, field_height_near's per-candidate scan, 9.2 of 12.9 profiled seconds) was fixed in this batch: one vector pass, the same answer, 19.3 -> 16.2 s. Seed 25's refusal at 40 households is the same re-seating (fourteen access lanes' first leg within 7 ft of a neighbor's yard), filed for the GM with the band-3 sign-off.
